a.xlink:title: Interrupt-driven specialization of the USB device port.
Defines the transfer mechanism a HAL peripheral port uses for its transfers.
Shared policy of the interrupt-driven USB device modes ("IT" and "DMA").
Shared open and close lifecycle of the interrupt-driven peripheral ports.
Shared USB device lifecycle and endpoint policy, common to every transfer mode.

Plain types shared by the USB device, host and OTG ports of the HAL layer, with no HAL dependency.
